cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_libsoil C)

# Find the package via Conan-generated CMakeDeps
find_package(libsoil REQUIRED)

# The test images (img_test.bmp/png/tga/dds) are BINARY files and are NOT
# committed: the CI `checkout-pr` step applies the platform-generated PR diff
# with `git apply`, and that diff carries no `GIT binary patch` data for newly
# added binary files, so the step fails before the package is ever built
# (CI #60156; same root cause as dbview PR #9495 / knowledge/doc/E256.md).
# They are regenerated byte-identically at configure time by make_images.py
# (python3 is available in the conan/CI environment). Failing loudly here is
# intentional: a missing generator must never be mistaken for "all tests
# passed".
set(IMAGES_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.bmp
           ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.png
           ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.tga
           ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.dds
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make_images.py ${IMAGES_DIR}
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/make_images.py
    COMMENT "Generating deterministic libsoil test images (make_images.py)"
    VERBATIM)
add_custom_target(generate_test_images ALL
    DEPENDS ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.bmp
            ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.png
            ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.tga
            ${IMAGES_DIR}/img_test.dds)

add_executable(test_libsoil test.c)
add_dependencies(test_libsoil generate_test_images)
target_link_libraries(test_libsoil libsoil::libsoil)

enable_testing()
# test.c takes argv[1] as the directory containing the test images
add_test(NAME test_libsoil
         COMMAND test_libsoil ${IMAGES_DIR})
